An unforgettable experience in Sushi Uraetei!
Mar 2019 • Family
What a pleasurable meal I have had in Sushi Uraetei, located in Crescent Mall!
As soon as My family and I stepped into Sushi Uraetei last weekend, we could not express the happiness that we immediately received, along with the hope of the quality. As many people around the town have introduced the restaurant to us, we were extremely delighted to have a feast there.
As soon as we arrived, we got surprised by the clean, and modern Japanese interior they had. The location of the tables were all very modern, which gave us a feeling that we have found the right restaurant for our feast.
Before you decide to come to the restaurant, it is definitely good to know that reservations are not available. To give further information, there are loads of people dashing in the restaurant especially from 6 pm on the weekends. Therefore, it is good to come around 5:30 pm to have dinner, without waiting for hours.
There are 3 main sections that we can divide the restaurant to. The conveyor belt, which is a shortened term for “The seats that have access to the conveyor belt”, the outside terrace, and ‘others’, which are the remaining tables left in the restaurant. We would definitely suggest you sitting in ‘others’ or the conveyor belt because firstly, the outside terrace may be too hot to sit for long hours, especially in the hot/dry season. Secondly, the wait time for the seats located in the conveyor belt takes the amount of time, as it is very popular and there are obviously limited spots.
There are a lot of menus, from sushi & rolls to different types of Japanese cuisines such as noodles, rice, seafood, salad, and even hotpot menus.
We ordered 2 different types of salmon sushi because it looked fresh, a bowl of udon, which is a Japanese type of noodle, Japanese style-chicken, and Japanese curry.
 As you see in the photo above, the two different types of salmon sushi, which is raw salmon and grilled salmon with cheese topping. While it looks extremely fresh and delicious, it also tastes so! I really felt that I never ate such delicious sushi like this. I felt I was lying down above the clouds with fairy wings attached, while the food melting down my throat.
And the same with the chicken as you see in the photo above. As soon as you spray the lime provided and start chewing it, it is really delicious, by showing a contrast of sweet and sour, with the inside extremely soft and well-cooked. It isn’t any exaggeration that this will be one of the items that I will never forget. I highly suggest you get this item! The curry was also delicious overall. However, it is that they provide a little amount of curry compared to the amount of rice, and the fact that the curry does not have any toppings such as vegetables and meat. However, to create a counterclaim against that, if you ask one of the staff members to give you more curry, they will refill it up for you. It was personally delicious for me. Yet, the taste gave me a feeling that some people wouldn’t like it, because it might be a little too salty for people who may be sensitive to taste.
I seriously, affirm to you at this place that it was a fabulous, enjoyable, and unregretful decision to come and seek for another positive moment in your life. There are more than 150 delicious cuisines other than what I tried. What we have noticed is that there are no people who leave the restaurant with a sad face.
Reading off my review, you might have worried that if the restaurant is too delicious, it would be very expensive. However, another shocking fact is that along with the taste, the price is extremely cheap, which increases the level of worth for us to go eat there. For example, the food upon the photo gave a total of 350,000 Vietnamese Dong, which is a really cheap price compared to other Japanese sushi restaurants, or probably most food restaurants in general downtown or in PMH. Along with that, if you live around Phu My Hung, it is also in a very comfortable location for you to transport as well.
A recommendation that I would make to the store, however, is that even though this was one of the best restaurants that I have tried sushi, is a request of swifter delivery of food. Even though it is not examined that their food delivery is ‘slow’, considering the fact that there are a lot of customers that order a lot of scrumptious cuisines, it also isn’t considered swift delivery when it takes nearly 30 minutes to get 10 pieces of Sushi. However, another reason that this restaurant is an amazing one is that there is always a replacement when there is a problem. Although the freshness might be a bit worse than the ordered ones, the Sushi and other food that gets transported by the conveyor-belt obviously fills the cup of customer’s contentment upwards. 
Overall, I would give a 4.8/5 for this restaurant. Anyways, I highly suggest you, that you would not regret your decision of trying this restaurant. As soon as the sushi goes in your mouth, you will automatically close your eyes and preview heaven. The perfect Japanese restaurant where the taste, service, price, and location is all fabulous. Come in Uraetei, and enjoy Uraetei!

Sushi Ur a LIE
Dec 2018 • Family
Sushi Ur a LIE.
 It is crucial for a Japanese restaurant this popular to at least excel in the basic foods they make. My family and I were looking for a place to eat but because of my brother’s keto diet(a diet where you can’t eat carbs), we couldn’t eat at an Italian place or something. So we were wandering around Crescent mall and we came across Sushi Uraetei. Because it was Japanese, there would be grilled fish or something which my brother could eat, therefore we ended up eating there. Because we did not make a reservation, we had to wait 20 min to get our table which shows that the service there was slow, and even though I agree this wasn’t completely their fault, it had brought my mood down a bit. But because of the long wait, I had expected the food to be really good and set my expectations high. Only to know that it was going to be plummeting down and down and down the drain.
 Despite what I said, the food wasn’t actually bad. It was just underwhelming. The first thing we ordered was the “Seafood Mix Fresh Vegetables” which was a salad composing of salmon and tuna sashimi. Seeing the salad on the menu it looked like it was big enough to feed four people. But when it came it was barely enough to feed two people. Not only that it’s quite pricey for its size as well. The salad was 100,000 with the size being fit for only two people and the sashimi was over 200,000! I also couldn’t tell if the sashimi was frozen or fresh. So we were off to a bad start. The second thing we got was our main courses. What I got was the cold soba. The soba was like every other Japanese place’s soba so nothing too special or bad there but the dip was kind of underwhelming. The broth that I received for the Cold Soba was truly tasteless. I had to dump a whole piece of wasabi into it and even then I couldn’t taste that much
 The service there was fine but they gave off this impression as if they were one of the best Japanese restaurants in Ho Chi Minh. They continuously asked if the food was good and once they even said “Our food is good right” with a smile on his face, not to mention, I’ve been to nearly a dozen of Japanese restaurants in Ho Chi Minh. Yet, Sushi Uratei did not seem to stand out to me at all.
 However, some good things I can say about this restaurant was the design, and, the interior of this restaurant looked as if it was a modern take on a traditional Japanese restaurant. Just with a conveyor belt. The lighting was great and the plates and atmosphere were pretty nice and I truly liked how it looked. It was as if we were on the moon and the sun was shining on us.
Overall, there was nothing really special about this place. Wouldn’t recommend this place to anyone looking for good Japanese food or if they wanted something that was truly worth their while. One place that I would recommend for Japanese food would be Ichiba Sushi Restaurant. However, if you don’t want to leave your house and you want to have good Japanese food, then Poke Saigon should be your pick. or if you don’t want to The design of the restaurant was nice but not enough to make it a good restaurant, after all, it always boils down to whether the food is good or not and this time, it wasn’t that great. Maybe they were having a bad day on us but I wouldn’t go here again if the food truly continued to taste like this.

Fancy restaurant, but...
Sep 2016 • Couples
We were excited when Uraetei opened their "sushi" type restaurant near our home. The first impression when we entered the restaurant is, "Wow, it's so Tokyo!" From automatic door, calling button on every table, until the traditional Japanese ryokan atmosphere, all strengthen the sense of authentic sushi restaurant. Unfortunately, the impression fade away when we recall our initial purpose to visit the restaurant: to enjoy sushi dinner.
I count that we have visited Sushi Uraetei 4 times. In all of those visits we need to take waiting list number. I expected that the food and service are good even people willing to queue so long. However, in every visit we were left to starve before getting our food. The gap between ordering time and serving time was so long. It took almost 30 minutes or more before we get our food. Even the technology is not helping. The calling button that provided on each table supposed to have function on calling the waiter. But they hardly notice our signal. 
In one visit, I almost lucky not to starve when the waiter seated us in conveyor area because we can grab any sushi circulating there. But, in the next visit where we sat in conveyor area, we did not see any "update" of sushi nor additional item in conveyor belt for almost one hour! I don't think someone intercepted all sushi before reaching our table. 
Regretfully, we decided not to visit this restaurant anymore until we hear some improvement. Honestly, the food is good and it has relatively cheaper price compared to other sushi restaurant in the district 7. But, I think the management should hire more staff to serve the customer better. I saw their staff were exhausted and I guess they don't have enough energy to fulfill order from customer on time.
